scenarios.name: quiet
scenarios.about: nominal robot, clean sensors, nothing happens for the whole test

scenarios.name: deploy_start
scenarios.about: starts on the baseline pose with command smoothing at 0 -- what deploy_standing does

scenarios.name: lean_6deg
scenarios.about: let go leaning 6 deg in a random direction

scenarios.name: lean_8deg
scenarios.about: let go leaning 8 deg in a random direction

scenarios.name: wobble
scenarios.about: let go rotating 0.6 rad/s about the feet, drifting 0.1 m/s

scenarios.name: pose_off
scenarios.about: joints start up to 0.1 rad off the standing pose

scenarios.name: push_4N
scenarios.about: 4 N on the upper torso for 0.2 s, every 3-4 s

scenarios.name: push_5N
scenarios.about: 5 N on the upper torso for 0.2 s, every 3-4 s

scenarios.name: push_6N
scenarios.about: 6 N on the upper torso for 0.2 s, every 3-4 s

scenarios.name: kick_1.5x
scenarios.about: 1.5x the trained velocity kick, every 3-4 s

scenarios.name: kick_2x
scenarios.about: 2x the trained velocity kick, every 3-4 s

scenarios.name: kick_3x
scenarios.about: 3x the trained velocity kick, every 3-4 s

scenarios.name: push_5N_gyro
scenarios.about: push_5N, and the gyro reads a false 0.12 rad/s (the 9/26 fault)

scenarios.name: push_5N_imu
scenarios.about: push_5N, and the IMU reports gravity 4 deg off

scenarios.name: push_5N_encoders
scenarios.about: push_5N, and every joint reads up to 3 deg off

scenarios.name: push_5N_noise
scenarios.about: push_5N, with the training sensor noise and biases

scenarios.name: push_5N_slow
scenarios.about: push_5N, every servo 1.5x slower and 25% weaker

scenarios.name: hardware_like
scenarios.about: deploy start leaning 3 deg + gyro 0.05 + IMU 2 deg + encoders 2 deg + noise + slower servos + 4 N pushes
